scope: Separate primitive guard cells only; no complete production source/path/property/persistence admission
windowsContentAndHeldObjectCells: observed exclusion for measured fixed local NTFS paths/aliases/mappings
windowsMetadataCell: timestamp changes allowed; property gate unverified
linuxAnonymousStageCell: named-stage poisoning prevented; bound inode and conditional absence observed
